sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学使命的一部分，旨在提升所有生物的生活质量。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but if you don't love maps, I don't think we can be friends anymore.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，如果你不喜欢地图，我想我们大概没法做朋友了。

sentences.en: I think there are people nowadays who'd admit that they don't love puppies and kittens and children, but nobody's going to admit that they don't love maps.
sentences.zh: 我想现在有些人会承认自己不喜欢小狗、小猫或小孩子，但没人会承认自己不喜欢地图。

sentences.en: Maps are awesome, as art, as story, as representation of truth, as representation of lies.
sentences.zh: 地图太棒了，它们既是艺术，是故事，是真理的呈现，也是谎言的呈现。

sentences.en: Really interesting visual information.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣的视觉信息。

sentences.en: It's a little bit like a puzzle.
sentences.zh: 它有点像拼图。

sentences.en: You're solving it.
sentences.zh: 你正在解开它。

sentences.en: It really engages your brain.
sentences.zh: 它确实能调动你的大脑。

sentences.en: But it also is an invitation in a way nothing else is.
sentences.zh: 但它同时也是一种独一无二的邀请。

sentences.en: You know, music, somebody else is playing it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，音乐是由别人演奏的。

sentences.en: But the map, it's a score for you to live your own life, to go there and do that.
sentences.zh: 但地图，它是为你谱写的乐章，让你去过自己的生活，去那个地方，做那些事。

sentences.en: Even if you're looking at 12th century Siberia or something, this is the kind of map I really like, along with maps of my own neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 即使你是在看12世纪的西伯利亚之类的地图，这也是我真正喜欢的地图，就像我喜欢自己社区的地图一样。

sentences.en: And if your only experience with maps is a triple A road atlas, then Rebecca Solnit's new book will blow your mind.
sentences.zh: 如果说你对地图的唯一体验就是美国汽车协会（AAA）的公路地图集，那么丽贝卡·索尔尼特的新书会让你大开眼界。

sentences.en: This is Rebecca Solnit with Infinite City, a San Francisco atlas.
sentences.zh: 这是丽贝卡·索尔尼特的《无限之城：旧金山地图集》。

sentences.en: It's both a collection of maps and a proposition that any city is infinite because it can be described in infinite ways.
sentences.zh: 它既是一本地图集，也是一个命题：任何城市都是无限的，因为它可以被无限地描述。

sentences.en: No one map tells you everything about a region.
sentences.zh: 没有哪一张地图能告诉你关于一个地区的一切。

sentences.en: It's 22 maps that want to be beautiful and want to celebrate old-fashioned map making with paper, with drawings, with old cartography,
sentences.zh: 这22张地图追求美感，旨在颂扬那种老派的地图制作方式——用纸张、用绘图、用古老的制图术，

sentences.en: with a sense of wonder and with practical information you can actually go to.
sentences.zh: 带着一种惊奇感，以及你可以实际前往的实用信息。

sentences.en: We each contain multitudes of maps.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人心中都包含着无数的地图。

sentences.en: If I say to you there were 99 murders in San Francisco in 2008, like, you know, you'd think it was deplorable for the three seconds before you completely forgot about it.
sentences.zh: 如果我告诉你2008年旧金山发生了99起谋杀案，你可能会觉得这很可悲，但在你彻底忘记它之前的这三秒钟里，你只会这么想。

sentences.en: But if I show you the actual map, it makes you think this person died here and that one over there.
sentences.zh: 但如果我给你看实际的地图，它会让你想到：这个人死在这里，那个人死在那里。

sentences.en: You see a pattern.
sentences.zh: 你看到了规律。

sentences.en: You see that most of them are on the east side of town.
sentences.zh: 你看到大多数案件都发生在城东。

sentences.en: You know, it becomes particular and specific.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它变得具体而明确了。

sentences.en: It becomes places you could have been.
sentences.zh: 它变成了你可能去过的地方。

sentences.en: It could have been you.
sentences.zh: 那个人也可能是你。

sentences.en: You can go to them.
sentences.zh: 你可以去到那些地方。

sentences.en: You could bring flowers.
sentences.zh: 你可以带上鲜花。

sentences.en: And in the San Francisco Infinite City Atlas, these murder sites are represented on the city map as red dots.
sentences.zh: 在《旧金山无限之城地图集》中，这些谋杀地点在城市地图上被标记为红点。

sentences.en: But alongside them is an array of green dots that represent all of the living Monterey Cypress trees in the city.
sentences.zh: 但在它们旁边，是一系列绿点，代表了城中所有存活的蒙特雷柏树。

sentences.en: It's new, ugly death and old, beautiful life side by side sharing a map because...
sentences.zh: 这是新的、丑陋的死亡与古老的、美丽的生命并排出现在同一张地图上，因为……

sentences.en: I mean, just because.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就是因为这样。

sentences.en: Because you can make a map do anything.
sentences.zh: 因为你可以让地图呈现任何东西。

sentences.en: My story is my story, but a map is also your story because you can literally enter what's shown on the map.
sentences.zh: 我的故事是我的故事，但地图也是你的故事，因为你可以真正进入地图上所展示的内容。

sentences.en: You can go there.
sentences.zh: 你可以去那里。

sentences.en: You can walk it.
sentences.zh: 你可以走过它。

sentences.en: You can be there.
sentences.zh: 你可以身临其境。

sentences.en: And so maps give you a different sense.
sentences.zh: 所以地图给了你一种不同的感知。

sentences.en: They quantify and locate and invite in a way that no other medium does.
sentences.zh: 它们以其他任何媒介都无法比拟的方式进行量化、定位和邀请。

sentences.en: Would you like any other maps that show other kinds of information?
sentences.zh: 你还想要其他展示不同信息的地图吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: One of the Infinite City maps is a treasure map with a panoply of treasured sites in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 《无限之城》中的一张地图是藏宝图，上面汇集了旧金山的各种宝藏地点。

sentences.en: You know, the Mission Dolores graveyard, Monocorones murals, the African Orthodox Church of St. John Coltrane, some labyrinths,
sentences.zh: 你知道，多洛雷斯教会墓地、单色壁画、约翰·柯川非洲东正教教堂、一些迷宫，

sentences.en: the nesting site of the great blue herons on Stow Lake.
sentences.zh: 还有斯托湖上大蓝鹭的筑巢地。

sentences.en: We have treasure.
sentences.zh: 我们有宝藏。

sentences.en: And this is the map to help you find it.
sentences.zh: 而这就是帮你找到它们的地图。

sentences.en: But the most curious feature about this map is that San Francisco isn't depicted as that little thumbnail at the end of the peninsula's thumb that it actually is.
sentences.zh: 但这张地图最奇特的地方在于，旧金山并没有被描绘成它实际的样子——半岛末端那个小小的缩略图。

sentences.en: San Francisco is drawn as an island.
sentences.zh: 旧金山被画成了一座岛屿。

sentences.en: On the treasure map, San Francisco not only has the north coast, east coast, and west coast you all know and love, it has a south coaSt.
sentences.zh: 在这张藏宝图上，旧金山不仅有你们所熟知和喜爱的北岸、东岸和西岸，它还有一个南岸。

sentences.en: There's a fictitious blue ribbon of water just north of San Bruno Mountain.
sentences.zh: 在圣布鲁诺山以北，有一条虚构的蓝色水带。

sentences.en: There's a lot of ways San Francisco really is an island in terms of its difference from the rest of the country ecologically, geographically, and culturally.
sentences.zh: 旧金山在生态、地理和文化上与全国其他地区截然不同，从这个意义上说，它确实是一座孤岛。

sentences.en: Before the bridges, you basically came in and out of San Francisco by boats, as though it was an island.
sentences.zh: 在桥梁建成之前，你基本上是乘船进出旧金山的，就像它是一座岛屿一样。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to make that literal in the wonderful way maps always are literal.
sentences.zh: 我只是想以地图总是那种美妙的字面意义，把这一点变成现实。

sentences.en: So Shiz, the cartographer Ben Pease's wife, Shizu Segal, obliged me by making San Francisco into an island.
sentences.zh: 所以，制图师本·皮斯的妻子，静·西格尔，满足了我的要求，把旧金山变成了一座岛屿。

sentences.en: Maps are powerful objects.
sentences.zh: 地图是有力量的物体。

sentences.en: They give direction.
sentences.zh: 它们指引方向。

sentences.en: They hide secret places.
sentences.zh: 它们隐藏秘密之地。

sentences.en: They can support imperialism and oppression.
sentences.zh: 它们可以支持帝国主义和压迫。

sentences.en: A newly designed map can create a nation state and present a false sense of absolute truth.
sentences.zh: 一张新设计的地图可以创造一个民族国家，并呈现一种绝对真理的虚假感。

sentences.en: They change the way we see the world.
sentences.zh: 它们改变了我们看待世界的方式。

sentences.en: I joked to some of my friends when I was working on this project that owning racehorses and castles says nothing to commissioning maps when it comes to a sense of power and luxury.
sentences.zh: 我在做这个项目时曾跟朋友开玩笑说，在权力和奢华感方面，拥有赛马和城堡根本比不上委托制作地图。

sentences.en: It's pretty amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》由我，罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了 Lunar 的支持。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects, San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是 KALW、美国建筑师协会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的一个项目。

sentences.en: Find out more at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
